messageValues.message: You are a cautious B2B solutions consultant drafting non-binding proposals. Return only valid JSON exactly as requested. Never invent prices or guarantees.
Generate a short, conservative B2B proposal draft. Return only the requested JSON object, and never change quoted amounts.

parameters.jsCode:
const payload = $json;
const q = payload.quotation;
const p = payload.proposal;
if (!q || !p) throw new Error('Missing quotation or proposal');
if (q.indicative_subtotal !== null && (!Number.isFinite(q.indicative_subtotal) || q.indicative_subtotal < 0)) {
  throw new Error('Invalid indicative quote amount');
}
const money = value => Number(value).toLocaleString('en-US',{minimumFractionDigits:2,maximumFractionDigits:2});
const lines = values => values.map(v => '- ' + String(v)).join('\n');
const price = q.indicative_subtotal === null
  ? 'Price requires manual scoping.'
  : `Illustrative service fee (USD, before taxes): $${money(q.indicative_subtotal)}.`;
const markdown = `# ${p.proposal_title}\n\n`
+ `**Proposal Reference:** ${q.quote_id}\n`
+ `**Client:** ${payload.company}\n`
+ `**Service:** ${payload.service_needed}\n\n`
+ `## Executive Summary\n${p.executive_summary}\n\n`
+ `## Proposed Solution\n${p.proposed_solution}\n\n`
+ `## Indicative Scope & Deliverables\n${lines(p.deliverables)}\n\n`
+ `## Assumptions\n${lines(p.assumptions)}\n\n`
+ `## Exclusions\n${lines(p.exclusions)}\n\n`
+ `## Timeline\n${p.timeline_note}\n\n`
+ `## Draft Quotation\n${price}\n\n`
+ `**IMPORTANT: DEMONSTRATION PRICE ONLY.** Not a binding offer. Taxes, discounts, final scope and any third-party charges require written confirmation.\n\n`
+ `## Suggested Next Steps\n${lines(p.next_steps)}\n\n`
+ `**Status:** Draft, pending sales review. Do not send automatically.`;
return {json:{
  status:'draft_pending_review',
  approval_status:'pending_review',
  opportunity_stage:'proposal_drafted',
  can_send:false,
  lead_id:payload.lead_id,
  company:payload.company,
  full_name:payload.full_name ?? null,
  email:payload.email ?? null,
  service_needed:payload.service_needed,
  lead_score:payload.lead_score ?? null,
  lead_priority:payload.lead_priority ?? null,
  quote_id:q.quote_id,
  quotation:q,
  proposal:p,
  proposal_markdown:markdown,
  ai_provider:payload.proposal_generator ?? 'unknown',
  ai_processing_status:payload.ai_processing_status ?? 'unknown',
  generated_at:new Date().toISOString(),
  draft_disclaimer:'Demo quote; requires human sales and finance review. No email, ERP posting, contract or payment action was performed.'
}};
